From 7d5cfafe8b4006a75b55c2f1fdfdb363f9a5cc98 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Guo Zhi <qtxuning1999@sjtu.edu.cn>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2021 21:48:57 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] RDMA/hfi1: Fix kernel pointer leak

Pointers should be printed with %p or %px rather than cast to 'unsigned
long long' and printed with %llx.  Change %llx to %p to print the secured
pointer.

Fixes: 042a00f93aad ("IB/{ipoib,hfi1}: Add a timeout handler for rdma_netdev")
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20210922134857.619602-1-qtxuning1999@sjtu.edu.cn
Signed-off-by: Guo Zhi <qtxuning1999@sjtu.edu.cn>
Acked-by: Mike Marciniszyn <mike.marciniszyn@cornelisnetworks.com>
Signed-off-by: Jason Gunthorpe <jgg@nvidia.com>

diff --git a/drivers/infiniband/hw/hfi1/ipoib_tx.c b/drivers/infiniband/hw/hfi1/ipoib_tx.c
index e74ddbe46589..15b0cb0f363f 100644
--- a/drivers/infiniband/hw/hfi1/ipoib_tx.c
+++ b/drivers/infiniband/hw/hfi1/ipoib_tx.c
@@ -876,14 +876,14 @@ void hfi1_ipoib_tx_timeout(struct net_device *dev, unsigned int q)
 	struct hfi1_ipoib_txq *txq = &priv->txqs[q];
 	u64 completed = atomic64_read(&txq->complete_txreqs);
 
-	dd_dev_info(priv->dd, "timeout txq %llx q %u stopped %u stops %d no_desc %d ring_full %d\n",
-		    (unsigned long long)txq, q,
+	dd_dev_info(priv->dd, "timeout txq %p q %u stopped %u stops %d no_desc %d ring_full %d\n",
+		    txq, q,
 		    __netif_subqueue_stopped(dev, txq->q_idx),
 		    atomic_read(&txq->stops),
 		    atomic_read(&txq->no_desc),
 		    atomic_read(&txq->ring_full));
-	dd_dev_info(priv->dd, "sde %llx engine %u\n",
-		    (unsigned long long)txq->sde,
+	dd_dev_info(priv->dd, "sde %p engine %u\n",
+		    txq->sde,
 		    txq->sde ? txq->sde->this_idx : 0);
 	dd_dev_info(priv->dd, "flow %x\n", txq->flow.as_int);
 	dd_dev_info(priv->dd, "sent %llu completed %llu used %llu\n",
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/infiniband/hw/hfi1/ipoib_tx.c`**
   - Changed the format specifier from `%llx` to `%p` for printing the pointer `txq` in the `hfi1_ipoib_tx_timeout` function.
   - Changed the format specifier from `%llx` to `%p` for printing the pointer `txq->sde` in the same function.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in the `ipoib_tx.c` file are related to improving the way kernel pointers are printed in the logging statements. By changing the format specifiers from `%llx` (which casts pointers to an unsigned long long) to `%p` (which is the correct format for printing pointers), the patch addresses a potential kernel pointer leak issue. This change enhances the security and correctness of the logging mechanism by ensuring that pointers are printed in a safe manner, thus fixing the bug identified in the commit message.

You will be given the root cause of a bug, the commit message and the corresponding patch.
        You need to extract all code statements that lead to the bug from the patch, based on the root cause and the commit message.

        Root cause:
        The bug was caused by using the incorrect format specifier `%llx` to print kernel pointers, which involved casting them to `unsigned long long`. This practice can lead to potential security vulnerabilities, such as pointer leaks, as it does not properly represent the pointer type and can expose sensitive memory addresses in logs.
        
        Commit message:
        RDMA/hfi1: Fix kernel pointer leak

Pointers should be printed with %p or %px rather than cast to 'unsigned
long long' and printed with %llx.  Change %llx to %p to print the secured
pointer.

 	struct hfi1_ipoib_txq *txq = &priv->txqs[q];
 	u64 completed = atomic64_read(&txq->complete_txreqs);
 
-	dd_dev_info(priv->dd, "timeout txq %llx q %u stopped %u stops %d no_desc %d ring_full %d\n",
-		    (unsigned long long)txq, q,
+	dd_dev_info(priv->dd, "timeout txq %p q %u stopped %u stops %d no_desc %d ring_full %d\n",
+		    txq, q,
 		    __netif_subqueue_stopped(dev, txq->q_idx),
 		    atomic_read(&txq->stops),
 		    atomic_read(&txq->no_desc),
 		    atomic_read(&txq->ring_full));
-	dd_dev_info(priv->dd, "sde %llx engine %u\n",
-		    (unsigned long long)txq->sde,
+	dd_dev_info(priv->dd, "sde %p engine %u\n",
+		    txq->sde,
 		    txq->sde ? txq->sde->this_idx : 0);
 	dd_dev_info(priv->dd, "flow %x\n", txq->flow.as_int);
 	dd_dev_info(priv->dd, "sent %llu completed %llu used %llu\n",
 		    txq->sent_txreqs, completed, hfi1_ipoib_used(txq));
 	dd_dev_info(priv->dd, "tx_queue_len %u max_items %lu\n",

 		    txq->tx_ring.head, txq->tx_ring.tail);
 	dd_dev_info(priv->dd, "wait queued %u\n",
 		    !list_empty(&txq->wait.list));
 	dd_dev_info(priv->dd, "tx_list empty %u\n",
 		    list_empty(&txq->tx_list));
 }
